subject: lavender
name: 薰衣草
label: 三枝薰衣草
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. Three graceful lavender stems at different heights with spaced broad bud clusters, long narrow leaves and a loose tied ribbon, no many tiny dots.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside the central 76% of the square with generous 12% clear margins. Pure black contour lines, open white interiors, no shading. Respect the low number of parts specified, no dense repeated small decorations.
